app.title: Flitnix
app.tagline: Fast, private file transfer over your local network.

connection.connectPrompt: Connect to Wi-Fi or Ethernet to continue
connection.incomingApprovalNotice: Incoming files always ask for approval.
connection.chooseInterfacePrompt: Choose the interface connected to your phone, then start a session.
connection.plainHttpNotice: ⚠ Plain HTTP is used on your trusted hotspot or LAN. Connect only devices you control.

workflow.sharedFilesDesc: Files listed here are available for direct download from the phone.
workflow.noSharedFiles: No files shared yet. Choose files or drop them here.
workflow.dropHint: Drop files or folders here. Folders are prepared privately for a future archive download.
workflow.folderItemSummary: Folder · {count} files · {size} · streamed ZIP available from the phone
workflow.inboxDesc: Review each request before any file contents reach this computer.
workflow.noPending: No files are waiting for approval.

quickText.title: Local Clipboard & Notes
quickText.desc: Share clipboard text, URLs, notes, and messages bi-directionally with connected phones.
quickText.placeholder: Type text, notes, or paste a link (http/https)…
quickText.noSessionHint: Start a pairing session above to share text and links with your phone.
quickText.noMessages: No text messages shared in this session yet.
quickText.missingTextError: Please enter some text before sending.

telemetry.pendingUploadDesc: A connected phone wants to upload a file to this computer. Confirm to receive it.
telemetry.pendingBatchesDesc: A connected phone wants to upload multiple files as a single batch.
telemetry.noActiveTransfers: No active transfers. Start a download or approve an incoming file to see live progress.

history.title: Completed in this session
history.noCompleted: No completed transfers in this session.

doctor.title: Connection Doctor
doctor.scanning: Scanning network interfaces, port 43821, and local connectivity…

guest.setupDesc: Start a temporary drop box room. Anyone in the room scans the QR code with their phone camera to upload files without installing an app. Files are saved in isolated guest subfolders.
guest.presetFamily: Family Gathering (3 hrs, duplicate names kept)
guest.noRecentUploads: No active or recent guest uploads.

templates.title: Collection Templates & Presets
templates.desc: Save room settings, submission forms, and rosters as templates to quickly launch recurring collection drop boxes.

audit.title: Transfer & Collection History
audit.desc: Append-only local JSONL audit trail. Network tokens and private transfer contents are never recorded.
audit.noEvents: No audit events match the current filter.

devices.title: Cryptographically Trusted Devices
devices.desc: Devices paired via cryptographic Ed25519 keys. Paired devices can be granted automatic approval to bypass the manual transfer prompt.
devices.noDevices: No trusted devices paired yet. Devices paired through connection authentication will appear here.

settings.title: Application Settings
settings.receiveDirDesc: Incoming files and folders from paired devices and guests are saved here.
settings.appearanceDesc: Choose the color scheme for the Flitnix user interface.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the display language for the Flitnix interface.
settings.preferredInterfaceDesc: Choose the network adapter used for pairing and transfers, or let Flitnix select automatically.
settings.autoStartSession: Automatically start pairing session on launch
settings.autoStartSessionDesc: When enabled, Flitnix prepares a connection immediately when opened so devices can pair right away.

footer.savedPath: Received files are saved to {path}. Paths stay on this computer.
